Trace orchestrates security agents to investigate threats, enrich IOCs, analyze files, and automate response actions.

Usage:
  trace [flags]
  trace [command]

Available Commands:
  admin       Administrative commands (org and user management)
  agent       Manage EDR agents and view status
  approval    Manage HITL approval requests
  build       Build artifacts (agent binaries for distribution)
  case        Manage security cases
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  compliance  Run compliance scans and generate audit-ready reports (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2)
  demo        Start a demo environment (server + agent + test data)
  edr         Manage EDR agents and dispatch remote actions
  genkey      Generate a self-signed TLS certificate and key
  help        Help about any command
  history     List recent investigations
  hunt        Manage automated threat hunts
  init        First-run setup wizard
  investigate Run a security investigation
  plugin      Manage external agent plugins
  report      Generate or view investigation report
  serve       Start the investigation server daemon
  server      Start in central server mode
  status      View investigation status
  tse         Trace Storage Engine management
  update      Update Trace or its data
  version     Print version information

Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file
  -h, --help            help for trace

Use "trace [command] --help" for more information about a command.
